name: HomeSafeBench (inspection)
summary: Evaluates hazard inspection by an embodied vision-language model that explores VirtualHome houses and reports hazards from first-person observations alone.
numbers: 1,000 inspection tasks, 5 hazard categories; best F1 34.7% vs 98.0% for humans

why.cog: Must find hazards, not just label them; models under-report.
